benchmark_method: Five sequential runs per binary per workload, alternating order; normal clocks; posix_spawn and per-child wait4; warm filesystem caches, no explicit warmup; raw outputs compared on every pair.
phase: Eighth pass: rolling LROH beta, in-place posteriors, LD metadata-guided decoding and buffer lifetimes
baseline_scope: Complete CLI regression against original commit with matching configurations; performance, LROH kernel and LD metadata probes against frozen seventh-pass delivery. Legacy LD reader probe against original commit. No Perl source changes.

normal_core.clock: fixed_time.c linked in both executables; no output normalization

normal_ld_metadata.clock: fixed_time.c linked in both executables; no output normalization

lapack.clock: fixed_time.c linked in both executables; no output normalization

lroh_probe.comparison: Raw posterior doubles from uninstrumented extracted kernels; instrumented variants additionally compare every alpha and beta double and must retain the same posterior bytes, final fenv flags and errno.
limits: Actual arithmetic blocks only; full CLI corpus separately checks observation collection, reports and buffer lifetimes.
The baseline can loop forever when a normalization row is exactly zero or negative; such multi-site inputs are excluded, not repaired.
Quiet NaN payloads are checked; signaling-NaN traps, asynchronous rounding-mode changes and untested excess-precision architectures are outside the evidence.
Posterior evaluation now runs backwards and interleaves with beta; instruction-level floating-trap and allocation-failure timing are not guaranteed.

ld_metadata_probe.scope: Actual reader definitions with read-call tracing; metadata, accepted genotype bytes, ifstream::read request lengths/order, final rdstate/gcount/position/remainder and thrown status match. Rejected-only candidate vectors stay unallocated.
limitations: Complete headers only; old packed zero-available-payload uninitialized reads excluded.
Actual EOF and injected badbit at a payload request; not arbitrary physical-device fault injection.
Default, badbit-only and failbit/eofbit/badbit exception masks checked; a failed record ends the probe before any malformed next header.
Reader protocol probe, not complete CLI or performance measurement.

ld_readers_probe.compiler:
Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.1.1.101)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin25.6.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin
ld_readers_probe.contract: Exact CHROM, POS, allele count, genotype order and values, final rdstate/gcount/position and remaining raw bytes on binary ifstreams.
limitations: Not a CLI regression or performance benchmark.
Headers are complete; malformed header behavior is unchanged and not tested.
Packed rows with zero available genotype bytes and nonzero samples are excluded because the baseline reads an uninitialized char.
Default stream exception mask; arbitrary OS I/O errors and exception-enabled streams are not modeled.

scratch_comparison.method: Complete raw-byte multisets; random private filenames ignored only. Public output files and diagnostics remain byte-exact.

limitations: Finite same-platform tests, not a universal guarantee for every input, compiler, architecture, math library or failure mode. Existing undefined behavior is not repaired.
CLI regressions use fixed clocks for diagnostics/RNG and compare raw bytes without tolerance, normalization or sorting. Normal-clock benchmarks retain elapsed-time diagnostic differences separately.

LROH forward/backward expressions and renormalization stay unchanged. Two beta rows and posterior reuse of the alpha first column change arithmetic-array payload from 40N to 16N+32 bytes on this platform: lower for N>=2, eight bytes larger for N=1. Vector metadata, observation buffers and whole-process memory are outside this payload bound.

LROH posterior evaluation now runs backwards and interleaves with beta. Actual kernel probes use FE_TONEAREST and nontrapping arithmetic, raw doubles, final errno and floating exception flags. Instruction-level trap timing, asynchronous rounding changes and untested excess precision are outside the evidence.

Baseline LROH normalization can loop forever for exactly zero or negative sums; such multi-site probe inputs are excluded, not repaired. Per-sample observation buffers are released only after their final report use.

LD rejects skip decoding, not payload reads. The same ifstream::read request sizes and order, including the final one-byte request and failed one-byte requests after short reads, are retained; this is not an OS-syscall or device-I/O trace.

LD stream probes cover complete headers, actual EOF, injected badbit at payload requests and three exception-mask settings; packed rows with zero available payload bytes and nonzero samples invoke baseline uninitialized-char behavior and are excluded. Arbitrary device faults are not exhaustively modeled.

LD accepted decoders overwrite complete vectors; GTs2 allocation is lazy and no site cache or data-sized skip buffer is introduced. Input entry and staging buffers are released after temporary writers close and original insufficient-site guards, before pair calculations.
Original signed dimension, coordinate and count overflow, invalid indexing, malformed-input undefined behavior and resource-exhaustion timing remain outside a universal byte-equivalence claim.
Statistical formulas, floating accumulation order within each recurrence/kernel, thresholds, windows, warning branches, pair ordering and output formatting are unchanged.
Perl source is unchanged; previous nondeterminism and missing-tabix limitations remain, with no prior pass counts added to current totals.
